name: Hermas
title: Christian brother in Rome
summary: Hermas was a Christian in Rome whom Paul greets in his letter to the Romans. He is mentioned as part of the early Christian community in the capital, representing the many faithful believers who made up the first congregation there.

keyEvents.title: Greeting from Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul sends greetings to Hermas along with other Christian brothers in Rome, showing that he was a recognized part of the congregation.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Christian community
keyEvents.description: Hermas is mentioned together with Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes and Patrobas, as well as other brothers who were with them, suggesting a house church or smaller group of believers.
